{"program":"domain(person,[jade,alyssa,faith,twinkle]).
% Jade does not map terrain.
axiom(s1,not(map_terrain(jade))).
% Alyssa does not map terrain.
axiom(s2,not(map_terrain(alyssa))).
% If Faith loves the outdoors, then she examines fossils and classifies minerals.
axiom(s3,rule([love_outdoors(faith)],and(examine_fossils(faith),classify_minerals(faith)))).
% Alyssa enjoys hiking.
axiom(s4,enjoy_hiking(alyssa)).
% Alyssa does not appreciate nature.
axiom(s5,not(appreciate_nature(alyssa))).
% Faith does not gain recognition.
axiom(s6,not(gain_recognition(faith))).
% If Twinkle enjoys hiking, then she either appreciates nature or loves the outdoors (but not both).
axiom(s7,rule([enjoy_hiking(twinkle)],xor(appreciate_nature(twinkle),love_outdoors(twinkle)))).
% Anyone who analyzes rock formations either studies geology or uncovers the secrets of the Earth (or both).
axiom(s8,rule([analyze_rock_formations(X)],or(study_geology(X),uncover_secrets_of_the_earth(X)))).
% Alyssa does not gain recognition.
axiom(s9,not(gain_recognition(alyssa))).
% If Alyssa values exploration, then she loves the outdoors.
axiom(s10,rule([value_exploration(alyssa)],love_outdoors(alyssa))).
% If Alyssa studies geology, then she can either make breakthroughs or gain recognition, but not both.
axiom(s11,rule([study_geology(alyssa)],xor(make_breakthroughs(alyssa),gain_recognition(alyssa)))).
% If Alyssa enjoys hiking, then she either appreciates nature or loves the outdoors (but not both).
axiom(s12,rule([enjoy_hiking(alyssa)],xor(appreciate_nature(alyssa),love_outdoors(alyssa)))).
% If Faith studies geology, then she can either make breakthroughs or gain recognition, but not both.
axiom(s13,rule([study_geology(faith)],xor(make_breakthroughs(faith),gain_recognition(faith)))).
% Jade does not uncover the secrets of the Earth.
axiom(s14,not(uncover_secrets_of_the_earth(jade))).
% If Alyssa loves the outdoors, then she examines fossils and classifies minerals.
axiom(s15,rule([love_outdoors(alyssa)],and(examine_fossils(alyssa),classify_minerals(alyssa)))).
% If Alyssa either finds fault lines or reads seismic data (but not both), then she studies geology.
axiom(s16,rule([xor(find_fault_lines(alyssa),read_seismic_data(alyssa))],study_geology(alyssa))).
% If Jade either examines fossils or maps terrain (but not both), then she analyzes rock formations.
axiom(s17,rule([xor(examine_fossils(jade),map_terrain(jade))],analyze_rock_formations(jade))).
% Jade enjoys hiking.
axiom(s18,enjoy_hiking(jade)).
% If Twinkle collects rocks, then she will classify minerals.
axiom(s19,rule([collect_rocks(twinkle)],classify_minerals(twinkle))).
% Alyssa does not uncover the secrets of the Earth.
axiom(s20,not(uncover_secrets_of_the_earth(alyssa))).
% If Alyssa either examines fossils or maps terrain (but not both), then she analyzes rock formations.
axiom(s21,rule([xor(examine_fossils(alyssa),map_terrain(alyssa))],analyze_rock_formations(alyssa))).","query":"labelled_explanation(make_breakthroughs(alyssa), Status, Package)"}
